message: My boots arrived with a torn sole, can I return them?
reply: I'm sorry about that. I've started a free return for you; a prepaid label is on its way to your email, and your refund goes out as soon as the boots reach us.

message: There's a payment on my card I don't recognise, $89 from yesterday.
reply: Thanks for flagging it. I've frozen your card to keep your account safe and opened a dispute for the $89 payment. You'll hear from our disputes team within 2 working days.

message: A pipe burst in my kitchen last night. How do I claim?
reply: I'm sorry to hear that. I've opened claim HX-2041 for you. Please upload photos of the damage and any receipts in the app, and an adjuster will call you within one working day.

message: My internet has been down since this morning.
reply: Sorry for the trouble. There's a known outage in your area, and engineers expect it fixed by 6 pm today. If it lasts past 24 hours, a day's credit is added to your bill automatically.

message: I was charged for the annual plan but meant to cancel. Renewal was 3 days ago.
reply: No problem. As you're within 14 days of renewal, I've cancelled the plan and refunded the unused part of the year. It should reach your card in 3–5 working days.

message: Can I move my flight on Friday to Sunday?
reply: Yes. As it's more than 24 hours before departure, the date change is free. I've moved you to Sunday's 10:40 flight, same seat class, and sent the new boarding details to your email.

message: My bill this month is double the usual amount.
reply: Thanks for checking with us. The bill used an estimated reading. If you send a meter reading today, I'll re-issue the bill based on your actual use.

message: I want to drop the statistics course, it's the first week.
reply: You can, and as it's within the first 2 weeks you'll get a full refund for the course. I've processed the withdrawal; it will show in your portal within a day.

message: I need to cancel tomorrow's appointment, something came up.
reply: That's fine. I've cancelled tomorrow's appointment. As this is your first late cancellation this year, there's no fee. Would you like me to find a new time?

message: My food is 40 minutes late and still not here.
reply: I'm sorry about the wait. Your driver is 5 minutes away, and as the order is more than 30 minutes late, I've refunded the delivery fee.
